import os
import sys
import tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))

import settings

FILES = {
    "full.ini": "[server]\nhost =  0.0.0.0 \nroot = /var/site\nport = 9090\ndebug = yes\n[logging]\nfile = /var/log/site.log\n",
    "partial.ini": "[server]\nroot = ./public\n",
    "empty.ini": "",
    "badport.ini": "[server]\nport = eighty\n",
}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    os.chdir(tmp)
    for name, text in FILES.items():
        with open(name, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
    for name in list(FILES) + ["missing.ini"]:
        try:
            print(name, sorted(settings.load_settings(name).items()))
        except ValueError as exc:
            print(name, "ValueError", exc)
    os.chdir("/")
print("ok")
